description: Creates a user with a generated password, returned here once (also readable with get_database_credentials); live within seconds. Up to 30 users. It connects only to its databases (every logical database, future ones included, when databases is omitted): it reads and writes everything there and creates tables (on PostgreSQL in public too), or only reads with read_only; elsewhere it has no access. Its connection_uri points to defaultdb, or to its first database without access to defaultdb. On Valkey, an ACL user with every key and data command (no databases, no read_only). Treat the password as a secret. Scope: databases.write.

database.description: Database id, as returned by list_databases or create_database.

databases.description: Logical databases it may connect to (existing ones, see get_database). Omit for all of them, future ones included.

items.description: Lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter or _.

read_only.description: SELECT only (MySQL, MariaDB: SELECT and SHOW VIEW). Default false.

username.description: Lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter or _.

name: create_database_user
title: Add a database user
